references.observed: Adult blue/green deep body with thin yellow horizontal stripes, black eye mask and tall dark opercular patch edged in blue, thick lips, blue median-fin margins and rounded yellow tail.

limitations: Original adult Pomacanthus imperator visual study based on the inspected Nick Hobgood Fiji photograph. Juveniles have a different ring pattern. Fine dentition and tiny opercular details are simplified; motion is artist-tuned, not measured behavior.
